reason: The repository is an interface customization plugin for DeepSeek Harness web UI: it adds a sidebar action to choose a local image, applies it as the app background through theme token overrides, offers a theme-aware readability matte control, and stores preference data locally in IndexedDB, with no evidence of external automation or analysis features.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供本地图片背景设置功能，可在侧边栏一键应用/清除背景，并通过主题相关遮罩参数调节可读性，设置会基于浏览器本地存储持久化。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a local-image background feature to DeepSeek Harness web UI, letting users apply or clear a full-interface background from the sidebar and tune a theme-aware matte for readability, with local persistence.

capabilities: Web UI background customization via client-side theme token override
Local image selection and preview/apply in browser
Client-side image handling and compression flow
Readability matte adjustment for light/dark themes
Persistent local settings storage using IndexedDB

reasons.code: Plugin description explicitly states local image upload, full-UI background application, and matte adjustment in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
Persistence model is declared as browser IndexedDB storage with no server-side storage, which still implies local data retention and storage quota considerations.
Package manifest declares web platform client injection and Cordis patch-based UI integration, indicating runtime execution in browser UI context.
